item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Your notes are empty, so start with a simple question: do you know exactly what you take, when, and why? If any part of that is fuzzy, that's your gap. Consistency matters more than perfection. Tie each dose to a daily habit you already do, so you stop relying on memory. Notice any side effects or missed doses honestly. Your action: write down your current medication routine in three lines today.
